keyPoints: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지, RSI 중립 구간 횡보 및 ADX 7.8 무추세 지속 확인.

keyPointsEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days, confirmed by RSI consolidation in the neutral zone and ADX at 7.8 indicating a lack of trend.
